verdict.rationale: Open-source availability is a fair question for any software product, including a web-based design tool like Spline, so the axis applies. The evidence never mentions Spline's own source code being published or released under an open license. Code export and the self-hosted ZIP that bundles the Spline runtime produce the user's scene output; they do not open-source the product and carry no stated license, so they are adjacent at best.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
